notes: Read only the packet, the role/method/knowledge files and the evidence it points to; no source, DESIGN.md, detector output or other evaluators' files were opened. Probe directories cited are under .ui-evaluator/runs/20261009-223245-audit-standard/probes/. Captured full-page screenshots draw the fixed 'Reserve this tool' bar mid-page (e.g. over the calendar at 1280 px); this is a capture artefact and is not reported. Viewport probe screenshots were used for anything involving the fixed bar. Probes 14 and 18 used a 300 ms wait and looked like Continue did nothing; probe 23 showed that navigation happens later (between 1 s and 4 s), so those probes support only the feedback-delay finding, not a 'blocked' claim. Two Bash invocations were refused by the permission system (a python one-liner and a multi-probe shell script); the probes were then run one at a time.

passes.summary: Walked reserve-tool-for-saturday and change-pickup-session end to end at 375 px (probes 8, 23, 27, 53, 57); reviewed captures for all 12 route states at 375 and 1280 light.

Element-by-element against H1-H10 on find, tool, basket, confirm and done, with adversarial probes: empty submit, invalid membership/phone, closed day, day before availability, session mismatch, Change round trip, Back after confirm, Escape on loan list, no-match search.
Cross-screen consistency pass: navigation, terminology (pick-up day / pick-up session / collect), search placement across widths, error pattern, success state, basket count across screens.

out_of_scope: controls_total counts the 63 distinct controls; inventory.json lists 219 entries because the header links, calendar days and radios repeat in every state. Every distinct control was exercised at least once (probes 8, 23, 27, 32, 41, 45, 48, 51, 53, 57, 63, 67).
Dark mode, colour-vision and 200% zoom variants were only glanced at in captures; contrast, target size and reflow belong to uie audit.
coverage.per_heuristic: H1-H10 considered on all five surfaces. Nothing found for H7 (no frequent-use flow where an accelerator is expected beyond what exists) or for H8 on basket/confirm/done.

task_suitability.task: Check the opening times and the deposit
task_suitability.evidence: Opening times region on find page (probes/63 'opening'); deposit on each card, tool page details, confirm and done.

not_assessable: Double submission of Confirm reservation (could create two reservations): not probed beyond a single click; the button shows no pending state (see H1 finding) but whether a second click submits again is unverified.
How long the basket actually holds a tool and what happens on expiry: cannot be waited out in a probe.
Whether Back from the done page followed by a second Confirm creates a duplicate reservation: probes/53 shows Back returns an editable confirm form; resubmission was not attempted.
Screen-reader announcement of the 'Added to your basket' status and of the confirm error summary focus: ARIA shows role=status and role=alert, but spoken output was not tested.

strengths.title: Confirm page errors are summarised at the top, linked to fields, worded with an example, and keep what was typed
strengths.evidence: probes/53 invalid.png: summary 'There is a problem' with links 'Enter your membership number, like FT-01234' and 'Enter a UK mobile number, like 07700 900123'; inline messages repeat them; 'Sam Patel', '01234' and '0161 496 0000' kept in the fields. Helps first-time members correct entries without retyping.

strengths.title: Reserving without a day gives an inline message at the calendar
strengths.evidence: probes/51 no-day.png: 'Choose a pick-up day first.' appears directly above the calendar, in the user's own terms.

strengths.title: Done page says exactly where to go, what to bring and what to do if the session is missed
strengths.evidence: done/default 375-light: reservation number, tool, session, 'Deposit to bring £20', and 'What happens next' with the address, card and deposit, and the desk phone number. Serves the critical journey's goal of turning up at the right session.

strengths.title: Deposit and 'nothing is paid online' are stated before committing
strengths.evidence: confirm/default ARIA: 'Deposit £20 in cash or by card at the desk' and 'Nothing is paid online. Bring the deposit and your membership card to the session.' Matches what members already know and removes payment doubt.

strengths.title: Calendar day buttons announce 'open' for session days and the chosen day is echoed in words
strengths.evidence: tool/default ARIA: button 'Saturday 17 October, open'; text 'Pick-up day: Saturday 17 October' after selection (tool/day-chosen). At 1280 px the word 'Open' is shown on session days.

strengths.title: Empty basket explains itself and links back to finding a tool
strengths.evidence: probes/57 aria.yml after Remove: 'Your basket is empty. Find a tool to reserve.'

candidates.title: Pick-up calendar accepts days on which the tool cannot be collected
candidates.description: Only session days (marked Open / green dot) are library sessions, and each tool has an 'Available from' date. The calendar nevertheless lets any day be chosen and added: Monday 12 October (no session) was accepted for the drill and the basket then reads 'Pick up Monday 12 October'; for the pressure washer, available from Saturday 17 October, Saturday 10 October was accepted with 'Added to your basket'. No warning is shown at either point.
candidates.impact: First-time members do not know which days are sessions (journey persona) and may hold a tool for a day the desk is closed or before the tool is back, then arrive to nothing.

evidence.detail: Monday 12 chosen, Reserve -> 'Added to your basket'; basket aria: 'Pick up Monday 12 October · one week · deposit £20'
pressure washer (Available from Saturday 17 October): Saturday 10 pressed, Reserve -> status 'Added to your basket'

factor_notes.frequency: Every reservation passes this calendar; 14 of 21 days shown are non-session days, and several tools have later availability dates.
factor_notes.impact: Nothing stops or warns; the later basket step asks for a session separately, so the wrong day can carry through to the confirm summary.

candidates.recommendation: Disable or clearly reject non-session days and days before the tool's available date.

candidates.title: Collection time is chosen twice, and the basket ignores the pick-up day already chosen
candidates.description: The tool page asks for a 'Pick-up day'; the basket then asks again for a 'Pick-up session' with no option selected, even though the item line above reads 'Pick up Saturday 17 October'. Pressing Continue without re-choosing gives 'Choose a pick-up session'. The two choices are independent, so a member can hold a day and a different session.
candidates.impact: A first-time member who already picked Saturday may be confused to be asked again and to get an error; the double model (day vs session) is likely to leave them unsure which date the desk will use.

candidates.title: Confirm summary shows two different collection dates after the session is changed
candidates.description: After Change -> Wednesday 21 October -> Continue, the 'Your reservation' box reads Tools: '... one week, pick up Saturday 17 October' and Pick-up session: 'Wednesday 21 October, 18:00 to 20:00'. A summary should state one collection date.
candidates.impact: The member checking the reservation before committing may not know whether to come on Saturday or Wednesday, which is the one thing the reservation depends on.

candidates.title: Continue and Confirm reservation show no response for over a second after the tap
candidates.description: After tapping Continue in the basket with a session chosen, the page is unchanged at 1 s (same button, same URL) and the confirm page appears only later (seen by 4 s). Tapping Confirm reservation likewise shows no change at the first capture. A tap should be acknowledged within 0.1 s and a wait over 1 s should show progress.
candidates.impact: Members on a phone may think the tap missed and tap again (on Confirm, possibly submitting twice) or leave the page.
